scripts.check: npm run check:be && npm run check:fe
scripts.check:be: cd backend && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run mypy && uv run pytest -q
scripts.check:fe: cd frontend && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:run
scripts.fmt: npm run fmt:be && npm run fmt:fe
scripts.fmt:be: cd backend && uv run ruff format . && uv run ruff check --fix .
